title: The Copa Petrobras São Paulo tennis tournament is established.
text: The Copa Petrobras São Paulo was a tennis tournament held in São Paulo, Brazil from 2009 until 2010. Between 2004 and 2008, it was held in Aracaju except for the 2007 edition which was held in Belo Horizonte.

title: Tour do Brasil is established
text: The Volta Ciclistica Internacional do Estado de São Paulo, also known as the Tour do Brasil, is a road cycling stage race held in the state of São Paulo. The race exists since 2004 as an elite men's competition over a prologue and 8 to 9 stages.
wiki: Volta Ciclistica Internacional do Estado de São Paulo

title: Hurricane Catarina hits the states of Santa Catarina and Rio Grande do Sul, leaving 2 dead and over 60 injured. This would be the first hurricane-strength tropical cyclone ever recorded in the Southern Atlantic Ocean.
text: Hurricane Catarina, or Cyclone Catarina was the only recorded hurricane-strength South Atlantic tropical cyclone. Catarina made landfall in the South Region of Brazil at peak intensity as a Category 2-equivalent tropical cyclone on 28 March 2004.

title: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signs a law creating the National Student Performance Examination; a written test, administered annually, used to evaluate Brazilian higher education courses.
text: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, known mononymously as Lula, is a Brazilian politician, trade unionist, and former metalworker who has served as the 39th president of Brazil since 2023. A member of the Workers' Party, he served as the 35th president from 2003 to 2011.

title: In three states and the Federal District, 14 are arrested by The Federal Police, after being accused of fraud in the purchase of medicines, primarily in the area of blood products for the Ministry of Health. This would be known as…
text: The Ministry of Health is a cabinet-level federal ministry in Brazil. Since March 2025, the Health Minister is Alexandre Padilha.

title: Brazil defeats Argentina 4-2 in penalties, to win their seventh Copa America trophy.
text: The 2004 Copa América final was the final of the 41st Copa América. The match was played in Lima, for the first time.

title: The Superior Electoral Court revokes the mandate of the governor of Roraima, Francisco Flamarion Portela, who is accused of committing irregularities in the 2002 general elections in the so-called Operation Gafanhoto.
text: The Superior Electoral Court is the highest body of the Brazilian Electoral Justice, which also comprises one Regional Electoral Court (Brazilian Portuguese: Tribunal Regional Eleitoral, TRE) in each of the 26 states and the Federal District of the country, as determined by the Article 118 of the Constitution of Brazil.

title: Sociedade Esportiva Recreativa Panambi
text: Sociedade Esportiva Recreativa Panambi, commonly known as Panambi, is a Brazilian football club based in Panambi, Rio Grande do Sul state.

title: Esporte Clube Tigres do Brasil
text: Esporte Clube Tigres do Brasil is a Brazilian football team from the city of Duque de Caxias, Rio de Janeiro state, founded on January 19, 2004.

title: Luverdense Esporte Clube
text: Luverdense Esporte Clube, commonly referred to as Luverdense, is a Brazilian professional club based in Lucas do Rio Verde, Mato Grosso founded on 24 January 2004.

title: Toledo Colônia Work
text: Toledo Esporte Clube, commonly known as Toledo, is a Brazilian professional association football club based in Toledo, Paraná, that competes in the Série D, the fourth tier of Brazilian football, as well as in the Campeonato Paranaense, the top division of the Paraná state football league.

title: Osvaldo Cruz Futebol Clube
text: Osvaldo Cruz Futebol Clube, commonly known as Osvaldo Cruz, is a Brazilian football club based in Osvaldo Cruz, São Paulo that competes in the Campeonato Paulista Segunda Divisão, the fourth tier of the São Paulo state football league.

title: Horizonte Futebol Clube
text: Horizonte Futebol Clube, commonly known as Horizonte, is a Brazilian football men's and women's team based in Horizonte, Ceará state. The men's team competed in the Série C and in the Copa do Brasil once, while the women's team competed in the Copa do Brasil de Futebol Feminino once.

title: Villa Rio Esporte Clube
text: Villa Rio Esporte Clube, usually known simply as Villa Rio, is a Brazilian professional football team from the city of Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro state founded in 2004.

title: Guanabara Esporte Clube
text: Guanabara Esporte Clube, usually known simply as Guanabara, was a Brazilian football team from the city of Araruama, Rio de Janeiro state. The club was founded on May 25, 2004.

title: Clube Esportivo Guará
text: Associação Botafogo Futebol Clube, also known as Botafogo or Botafogo-DF, is a Brazilian football club based in Cristalina, in Goiás. The club was formerly known as Clube Esportivo Guará.

title: São Domingos Futebol Clube
text: São Domingos Futebol Clube, commonly known as São Domingos, was a Brazilian football club based in São Domingos, Sergipe state. They competed in the Copa do Brasil twice.

title: Barras Futebol Club
text: Barras Futebol Club, commonly known as Barras, is a Brazilian football club based in Barras, Piauí state. They competed in the Série C twice and competed in the Copa do Brasil once.

title: São Carlos Futebol Clube
text: São Carlos Futebol Clube, more commonly referred to as São Carlos, is a Brazilian football club based in São Carlos, São Paulo. Founded on 25 November 2004, they play in blue and yellow shirts, blue shorts and socks.

title: São Bernardo Futebol Clube
text: São Bernardo Futebol Clube, commonly referred to as São Bernardo, is a professional association football club based in São Bernardo do Campo, São Paulo, Brazil. The team competes in Série B, the second tier of Brazilian football, as well as in the Campeonato Paulista Série A1, the top division of the São Paulo state football league.

title: Cristóvão Tezza – O Fotógrafo
text: Cristóvão Tezza is a Brazilian novelist and university professor.

title: Vinicius Cantuária – Horse and Fish
text: Vinicius Cantuária is a Brazilian singer, songwriter, guitarist, drummer, and percussionist. He is associated with bossa nova and Brazilian jazz.

title: Ithamara Koorax – Cry me a River
text: Ithamara Koorax is a Brazilian jazz and pop singer. For several years, she was voted one of the best jazz singers of the world by DownBeat Readers Polls.
